label: LIMITING_PRINCIPLE_2: X is composite under the supplied Composite predicate, or its supplied esse…
definition: x is composite under the supplied Composite predicate, or its supplied esse value differs from its supplied essence value, or some being other than x is prior to x under the supplied priority relation. Exactly these three disjuncts.
note: Open analyst proxy for the limiting or receiving principle in candidate UNRECEIVED-ESSE-INDIVIDUATION-BRIDGE; not a source definition. A difference of whole essences is not by itself a limiting principle here, so the different-whole-essence rival is not excluded by naming. What would source it: a materialized passage giving an exhaustive account of limitation that independently matches these disjuncts.
